rationale: Combinatorial dual-guide CRISPR screen of 461 DNA-repair genes in eHAP-iCas9 cells (Olivieri et al., PMID 41546867). Each construct is a guide pair; GEO deposits an IR file (IR_day15 rep1-2) and a basal file (day0/day14 rep1-3) with no series matrix, merged on the 809,460 shared construct ids by prepare.R. BARCS models single-construct abundance, NOT the paper's core genetic-interaction (epistasis) analysis between guide pairs, which is out of scope. The interpretable output is single-gene abundance: constructs pairing a gene with a non-targeting guide (or the same gene twice) aggregate under that gene (459 genes), nt+nt pairs are the controls (752 constructs), and gene-pair labels (A_B) are present only so library totals are computed over the whole library; their values must not be read as genetic-interaction results. Primary contrast IR_day15 vs control_day14 (2 vs 2, 2 residual df): single-gene depletion = genes whose loss sensitizes to ionizing radiation.
